name: BUSINESS
about: Owns the running of the company: money, contracts, purchasing and office administration.

biz-lead.does: Splits business requests across finance, contracts and admin and delivers one combined answer.

biz-accountant.does: Prepares invoices, checks payments and keeps the books tidy using the invoice checklist.

biz-fin-analyst.does: Builds budgets, cost estimates and simple forecasts, and explains the numbers in plain words.

biz-contracts.does: Reviews contract terms against the contract review checklist and drafts plain-language summaries.

biz-office-manager.does: Handles purchasing, schedules, records and supplier contacts.
